verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              द्रौपदेयान्महेष्वासान् सौमदत्तिर्महायशाः। एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said The illustrious son of Somadatta piercing each of those mighty bow men, the sons of Draupadi with five shafts, again pierced them with seven.

verses.sanskrit: ते पीडिता भृशं तेन रौद्रेण सहसा विभो। प्रमूढा नैव विविदुर्मृधे कृत्यं स्म किंचन ॥२॥
नाकुलिश्च शतानीकः सौमदत्तिं नरर्षभम्। द्वाभ्यां विद्ध्वाऽनदद्धृष्टः शराभ्यां शत्रुकर्शनः ॥३॥
verses.english: Thereafter that crusher of foes, namely Nakula's son Shatanika piercing that best of men viz., Somadatta's son with two arrows, became filled with joy and uttered a loud roar.

verses.sanskrit: तथेतरे रणे यत्तास्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। विव्यधुः समरे तूर्णं सौमद‌त्तिममर्षणम् ॥४॥
verses.english: The rest of the brothers, then exerting their best in battle, pierced the irate son of Somadatta, each with ten straight-flyings arrows.

verses.sanskrit: स तान् प्रति महाराज पञ्च चिक्षेप सायकान्। एकैकं हृदि चाजघ्ने एकैकेन महायशाः ॥५॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, the illustrious son of Somadatta sped at them five arrows and with each of those struck each of the brothers on the chest.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भ्रातरः पञ्च शरैर्विद्धा महात्मना। परिवार्य रणे वीरं विव्यधुः सायकैर्भृशम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Thereupon those five brothers pierced by the arrows of that high-souled one, surrounding the hero, wounded him soon with their arrows.

verses.sanskrit: आर्जुनिस्तु हयांस्तस्य चतुर्भिर्निशितैः शरैः। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥७॥
भैमसेनिर्धनुश्छित्वा सौमदत्तेर्महात्मनः। ननाद बलवन्नादं विव्याध च शितैः शरैः ॥८॥
verses.english: The son of Bhimasena cutting of the bow of the illustrious son of Somadatta, uttered a fierce roar and pierced the latter with numerous sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: यौधिष्ठेरिर्ध्वजं तस्य छित्त्वा भूमावपातयत्। नाकुलिश्चाथ यन्तारं रथनीडाद‌पाहरत् ॥९॥
verses.english: The son of Yudhishthira felled his standard having at first cut it off, so also Nakula's son felled his charioteer from its place on the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: साहदेविस्तु तं ज्ञात्वा भ्रातृभिर्विमुखीकृतम्। क्षुरप्रेण शिरो राजन्निचकर्त महात्मनः ॥१०॥
तच्छिरो न्यपतद्भूमौ तपनीयविभूषितम्। भ्राजयत्तं रणोद्देशं बालसूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Then that head fell down on ground beautifying the field of battle-head that was adorned with gold and that equalled in effulgence the newly-risen sun.

verses.sanskrit: सौमदत्तेः शिरो दृष्ट्वा निहतं तन्महात्मनः। वित्रस्तास्तावका राजन् प्रदुद्रुवुरनेकधा ॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding the illustrious son of Somadatta slain and his head roll on the ground, your troops, O king, greatly frightened, began to fly in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: अलंबुषस्तु समरे भीमसेनं महाबलम्। योधयामास संक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणं रावणिर्यथा ॥१३॥
verses.english: Alambusha filled with rage, fought on with the highly powerful Bhimasena, like the son of Ravana fighting with Lakshmana.

verses.sanskrit: संप्रयुद्धौ रणे दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ नरराक्षसौ। विस्मयः सर्वभूतानां प्रहर्षः समजायत ॥१४॥
आर्ष्यशृंगिं ततो भीमो नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। विव्याध प्रहसन् राजन् राक्षसेन्द्रममर्षणम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Then, O king, with nine shafts of depressed knots, Bhima smilingly pierced, O king, that wrathful son of Rishyshringa, that foremost of Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: तद्रक्षः समरे विद्धं कृत्वा नादं भयावहम्। अभ्यद्रवत्ततो भीमं ये च तस्य पदानुगाः ॥१६॥
स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्वा शरः सन्नतपर्वभिः। भैमान् परिजघानाशु रथांस्त्रिशतमाहवे ॥१७॥
verses.english: That Rakshasa then piercing Bhima with five arrows of depressed knots, quickly slew three hundred car-warriors engaged supporting Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चतुःशतान् हत्वा भीमं विव्याध पत्रिणा। सोऽतिविद्धस्तथा भीमो राक्षसेन महाबलः॥१८॥
verses.english: Once more slaying four hunderd warriors, he pierced Bhima with winged shafts. Then thus deeply peirced by that Rakshasa, the highly puissant Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: निपपात रथोपस्थे मूर्च्छयाऽभिपरिप्लुतः। प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां मारुतिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Squatted down on the terrace of his car, being overwhelmed with a swoon. Regaining his senses, the son of Maruta, overwhelmed with rage.

verses.sanskrit: विकृष्य कार्मुकं घोरं भारसाधनमुत्तमम्।  अलंबुषं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरर्दयामास सर्वतः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Stretched his dreadful and excellent bow capable of bearing a great strain and then he wounded Alambusha on all parts of his body with sharp shafts

verses.sanskrit: स विद्धो वहुभिर्बाणैर्नीलाञ्जनचयोपमः। शुशुभे सर्वतो राजन् प्रफुल्ल इव किंशुकः ॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus pierced with many shafts that Rakshasa resembling a heap of antimony looked beautiful, O king like a Kinshuka tree decorated with flowers.

verses.sanskrit: स वध्यमानः समरे भीमचापच्युतैः शरैः।  स्मरन् भ्रातृवधं चैव पाण्डवेन महात्मना ॥२२॥
verses.english: Thus struck in that battle with arrows shot from Bhima's bow and recollecting the slaughter of his brother by that illustrious son of Pandu, the Rakshasa.

verses.sanskrit: घोरं रूपमथो कृत्वा भीमसेनमभाषत। तिष्ठेदानीं रणे पार्थ पश्य मेऽद्य पराक्रमम् ॥२३॥
बको नाम सुदुर्बुद्धे राक्षसप्रवरो बली। परोक्षं मम तद्धृत्तं यद्भ्राता मे हतस्त्वया ॥२४॥
verses.english: O you of perverted understanding, I had a brother by name Baka who was the foremost of the Rakshasas and endued with great prowess. He was slain by you; but that transpired out of my sight.'

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो भीममन्तर्धानं गतस्तदा। महता शरवर्षेण भृशं तं समवाकिरत् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Having thus spoken to Bhima, he became invisible then and there; and then he covered the former with a thick shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: भीमस्तु समरे राजन्नदृश्ये राक्षसे तदा। आकाशं पूरयामास शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः ॥२६॥
स वध्यमानो भीमेन निमेषाद्रथमास्थितः। जगाम धरणीं चैव क्षुद्रः खं सहसाऽगमत् ॥२७॥
उच्चावचानि रुपाणि चकार सुबहूनि च। अणुर्बृहत्पुनः स्थूलो नादान्मुञ्चन्निवाम्बुदः ॥२८॥
verses.english: He assumed forms countless and large and small. Sometimes assuming subtle, sometimes a gross and sometimes a huge form, he began to roar like the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचास्तथा वाचो व्याजहार समंततः। निपेतुर्गगनाच्चैव शरधाराः सहस्रशः ॥२९॥
verses.english: He spoke diverse kinds of words and uttered speeches everywhere. From the welkin then fell thousands of arrowy showers.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तयः कणपाः प्रासाः शूलपट्टिशतोमराः। शतघ्न्यः परिघाश्चैव भिन्दिपालाः परश्वधाः ॥३०॥
verses.english: As also darts, Kunapas lances, pikes axes, spears, rockets, spiked maces, short javelins, battle-axes, rocks, scimitars treacle and swords and thunder bolts. That dreadful shower of weapons created by that Rakshasa.

verses.sanskrit: शिलाः खड्गा गुडाश्चैव ऋष्टीर्वज्राणि चैव ह। सा राक्षसविसृष्टा तु शस्त्रवृष्टिः सुदारुणा ॥३१॥
जघान पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकान् रणमूर्धनि। तेन पाण्डवसैन्यानां सुदिता युधि वारणाः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Slaughtered the soldiers of Pandu's son on the field of battle. In consequence of showers of weapons, many elephants of the Pandava host were killed.

verses.sanskrit: हयाश्च बहवो राजन् पत्तयश्च तथा पुनः। रथेभ्यो रथिनः पेतुस्तस्य नुन्नाः स्म सायकैः ॥३३॥
verses.english: As also numerous steeds and foot-soldiers, O king. Slain by the shafts of the Rakshasa, many car-warriors were dislodged from their seats in the car.

verses.sanskrit: शोणितोदां रथावर्तां हस्तिग्राहसमाकुलाम्। छत्रहंसां कर्दमिनीं बाहुपक्षगसंकुलाम् ॥३४॥
नदीं प्रावर्तयामास रक्षोगणसमाकुलाम्। वहन्तीं बहुधा राजंश्चेदिपञ्चालसृञ्जयान् ॥३५॥
verses.english: The Rakshasa then caused a river to flow on the field of battle, the waters of which were constituted by blood and eddies by cars; which abounded in alligators constituted by the elephants, which has the umbrellas of carwarriors for its swans and the flesh and marrow of animals for its mire; which was infested with snakes formed by the severed arms of human beings; which was frequented by many Rakshasas and other cannibals; and O king, which carried with its currents numerous Chedis, Panchalas and Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: तं तथा समरे राजन् विचरन्तमभीतवत्। पाण्डवा भृशसंविग्नाः प्रापश्यंस्तस्य विक्रमम् ॥३६॥
verses.english: 0 monarch, seeing him careering dauntlessly on the field of battle and beholding his prowess, the Pandava became filled with anxious thought.

verses.sanskrit: तावकानां तु सैन्यानां प्रहर्षः समजायत। वादित्रनिनदश्चोग्रः सुमहान् रोमहर्षणः ॥३७॥
verses.english: The soldiers of your army were then filled with delight; the musical instruments were then struck up emitting fierce and deep sound, making the hair to stand erect.

verses.sanskrit: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं तव सैन्यस्य पाण्डवः। नामृष्यत यथा नागस्तलशब्दं समीरितम् ॥३८॥
verses.english: Then hearing that mighty uproar of delight caused by your troops, the son of Pandu (Bhima) did hot tolerate it, even like a snake not tolerating the sound of the palm-stroke.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रोधाभिताम्राक्षो निर्दहन्निव पावकः। संदधे त्वाष्ट्रमस्त्रं स स्वयं त्वष्टेव मारुतिः ॥३९॥
verses.english: Then with his eyes coppery in rage and consuming the foe like fire itself, the son of Maruta invoked the Tvashtra weapon like the god Tvashtri himself.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रादुरासन् समन्ततः। तैः शरैस्तव सैन्यस्य विद्रवः सुमहानभूत् ॥४०॥
verses.english: Thereupon a thousand shafts started into existence from all sides. Great was the carnage that was then created in your troops by those arrows of Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: तदस्त्रं प्रेरितं तेन भीमसेनेन संयुगे। राक्षसस्य महामायां हत्वा राक्षसमार्दयत् ॥४१॥
verses.english: That weapon discharged by Bhimasena in battle, nullifying the mighty illusion of the Rakshasa, began to afflict the Rakshasa himself.

verses.sanskrit: स वध्यमानो बहुधा भीमसेनेन राक्षसः।  सन्त्यज्य समरे भीमं द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत् ॥४२॥
तस्मिंस्तु निर्जिते राजन् राक्षसेन्द्रे महात्मना। अनादयन् सिंहनादैः पाण्डवाः सर्वतो दिशं ॥४३॥
verses.english: Then, O king, when that foremost of the Rakshasas had been worsted by the illustrious Bhimasena, the Pandavas filled the quarters with the echoes of their war-cries.

verses.sanskrit: अपूजयन् मारुतिं च संहृष्टास्ते महाबलम्। प्रह्रादं समरे जित्वा यथा शक्रं मरुद्गणाः ॥४४॥
verses.english: Then filled with delight, they applauded the mighty son of Maruta the Marutas themselves applauded Shakra after he had vanquished Pralhada in battle. as
